market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed hike, consumer stress, and Morgan Stanley's 7% drawdown warning. Trump-Xi summit provides near-term catalyst for risk-on. Oil volatility and gas prices pressure consumer sentiment. Expect choppy, range-bound action with bond rotation continuing. Chip stocks may lead early gains but AI names face rate sensitivity.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes intact: energy transition (LNG, copper, utilities), India capital deployment, AI infrastructure buildout. Consumer weakness may moderate as policy responds. Buffett succession creates governance uncertainty at Berkshire but $187B cash signals eventual deployment. European banks and global-reach equities offer earnings upside. Housing affordability crisis may persist 12+ months.
